description: Create user skins (PC and mobile) for the blockman module - list and detail views - plus admin tab navigation, appeal board link logic, and Detail controller modification to pass list_access_level.
steps: 1. Modify controllers/Detail.php to also pass $list_access_level to the template via Context::set('list_access_level', $config->list_access_level ?? 'member') after the existing Context::set calls.

2. Create views/admin/_header.blade.php with the shared admin header containing: (a) page-header div with h1 showing $lang->blockman, (b) ul.x_nav.x_nav-tabs with 3 tabs: '설정' linking to dispBlockmanAdminConfig, '제재 관리' linking to dispBlockmanAdminList, '제재 처리' linking to dispBlockmanAdminAction. Active tab determined by $act variable. Follow the pattern from /projects/sandbox/attendance/views/admin/_header.blade.php and /projects/sandbox/rhymix/modules/board/tpl/header.html.

3. Modify views/admin/config.blade.php: Replace the existing

...

at the top with @include('_header').

4. Modify views/admin/list.blade.php: Replace the existing

...

at the top with @include('_header').

5. Modify views/admin/action.blade.php: Replace the existing

...

at the top with @include('_header').

6. Create skins/default/list.blade.php - PC user list skin showing ban records in a table with columns: nickname, user_id, start_date, duration (via BanRecord::formatDuration), reason_tags, status badge. Include search form for user_id, pagination via @include('common.paginate'), and empty state message. Use $ban_list, $page_navigation, $total_count, $search_user_id variables from controller.

7. Create skins/default/detail.blade.php - PC user detail skin showing: (a) basic info section with nickname, user_id, ban_type, duration, start/end dates, status; (b) reason section with reason_tags and reason_detail; (c) appeal section (only shown when $appeal_board_mid is not empty AND $list_access_level === 'member') containing appeal guide text and a link to /{$appeal_board_mid} that is active only when $appeal_window_open is true; (d) member history table. Use $ban_record, $member_history, $appeal_window_open, $duration_text, $start_date_formatted, $end_date_formatted, $appeal_board_mid, $list_access_level variables.
8. Create m.skins/default/list.blade.php - Mobile user list skin (simplified/responsive version of PC list skin with same data and functionality).
9. Create m.skins/default/detail.blade.php - Mobile user detail skin (simplified/responsive version of PC detail skin with same appeal logic).
10. Create skins/default/skin.xml - Basic skin metadata XML file for the PC default skin.
11. Create m.skins/default/skin.xml - Basic skin metadata XML file for the mobile default skin.
acceptance_criteria: controllers/Detail.php passes list_access_level to the template
views/admin/_header.blade.php exists with proper tab navigation
All 3 admin templates include _header instead of inline page-header
skins/default/list.blade.php renders ban_list table with pagination
skins/default/detail.blade.php shows ban record details with conditional appeal section
Appeal section only visible when appeal_board_mid is set AND list_access_level is 'member'
Appeal link only active (clickable) when appeal_window_open is true
m.skins/default/list.blade.php and detail.blade.php exist with same logic
Both skin.xml files exist with proper metadata
All PHP files pass php -l lint check
